Oh. Oh, it's an image we can build on. Aggressive, unpleasant, keeping to themselves. Now, is it just coincidence that the Ghorman personality seems so in tune with these creatures? The secrecy, the overcharging, mocking Imperial protocols. Laughing at us—''"
"''Okay. Yep. We, uh… We get the idea.|Nisus Osar and Orson Krennic|audio=Osar-Krennic-OYL.flac|}} '''Nisus Osar''' was a [[Human]] [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Ministry of Enlightenment]]. In [[4 BBY]], along with fellow Ministry of Enlightenment official, [[Dee Shambo]], Osar attended a clandestine [[Maltheen Divide conference|meeting]] with [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] officials at the [[Maltheen Divide]]. There, when introduced to the group by [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]], Osar and Shambo boasted that they had controlled the public image of the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. The public perceived the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghor]] as troublesome, arrogant, and selfish after an [[Imperial Navy|Imperial naval]] inspector was [[Death|killed]] on the planet, all of which Osar and Shambo took credit for. {{Char-stub}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Hasn't there always been something slightly arrogant about the Ghor? Oh, we all feel it. What is that?|Nisus Osar|audio=Osar-ArrogantGhor-OYL.flac|}} Nisus Osar had light skin, [[Color|green]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]]. ==Behind the scenes== Nisus Osar was portrayed by actor [[Tom Durant-Pritchard]].{{Andor|One Year Later}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Nisus Osar|imagecat=Images of Nisus Osar}} *''[[Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss]]'' {{Ab|Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss (audiobook)}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|f6UQ_lPBUhU|Andor Season 2 | The Tightest of Closed Circles | Now Streaming on Disney+}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Nisus Osar |ja=ナイサス・オーサー |ka=ნაისას ოსარი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Osar, Nisus}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]]
